message.reasoning_content:
The watch is a Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso Classic with small seconds, stainless steel, leather strap. Reference likely 2438522 (Reverso Classic Small Seconds 42.9 x 25.5mm steel) — Actually JLC Reverso Classic Small Seconds steel is ref. 213.8.42 / Q2438522? Let me think.

Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso Classic Medium Small Seconds steel: reference Q2438522 (243.8.52). The "Reverso Classic Medium Small Seconds" steel case 42.9 x 25.5 mm. Ref 2438522 is Monoface Small Seconds Medium in steel. Hmm.

Actually the Reverso Classic Small Seconds (large, 45.6 x 27.4mm) steel is ref 3858522... Let me recall: Q3858522 is Reverso Classic Large Small Seconds? Hmm.

Known references:
- Reverso Classic Medium Thin: Q2548520
- Reverso Classic Medium Small Seconds: Q2438522 (steel, silver dial)... I believe Q2438522 is the "Reverso Classic Small Seconds" steel with leather strap.
- Reverso Classic Large Small Seconds: Q3858522.

The dial here: silvered with guilloché texture in center, Arabic numerals, small seconds at 6, blued hands. That matches Reverso Classic Small Seconds Medium (Q2438522). Diameter 42.9 x 25.5 mm — the photo looks like a large-ish watch on the wrist but reasonably medium.

I'll go with Q2438522, movement manual (JLC caliber 822), case stainless steel, bracelet leather. Confidence ~0.45.

Actually reference format JLC uses "Q2438522". The "Q" prefix is common. Good.

Movement: manual.
